title.zh: Bitcoin ETFs shed $450M in biggest outflow since June
title.en: Bitcoin ETFs shed $450M in biggest outflow since June

current_state.zh: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded their largest daily net outflow since June 24 at $450.4 million, led by Fidelity's FBTC and BlackRock's IBIT, as Bitcoin fell 2.5% and the CLARITY Act failed to advance in the Senate.
current_state.en: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded their largest daily net outflow since June 24 at $450.4 million, led by Fidelity's FBTC and BlackRock's IBIT, as Bitcoin fell 2.5% and the CLARITY Act failed to advance in the Senate.
